gerenciador.youDonTHavePermission: You don't have permission to view production.

gerenciador.noVehiclesRegisteredAddOne: No vehicles registered. Add one in Settings › Production › Vehicles.

gerenciador.noManagerConfiguredCreateOne: No manager configured. Create one per sector in Settings › Production.
gerenciador.toKnowWhenAJob: To know when a job can be scheduled or promised.
gerenciador.noActiveProductionBoardCreate: No active production board. Create one per department in Settings › Production.
gerenciador.theNextDaysWithWhat: The next {DAYS} days, with what was assigned to the person or what they are doing now.
gerenciador.noScheduledTaskHasA: No scheduled task has a person assigned in the coming days.
gerenciador.teamMemberOnTheTask: Team member on the task: the clock started
gerenciador.linkYourUserToA: Link your user to a collaborator
gerenciador.pausedJobsResumeWithThe: Paused jobs resume with the time left.
gerenciador.inOrderOfArrivalSchedule: In order of arrival. Schedule the day to join the machine's queue.
gerenciador.jobSMovedDownThe: {moved} job(s) moved down the machine's sequence because of a delay. The forecast shows the new time and the previous one.
gerenciador.noOneHasAccessTo: No one has access to this board. Set it up in Settings › Production.
gerenciador.finishesOrReleasesTheNext: finishes or releases the next step.

gerenciador.noAttachmentsTheArtworkGoes: No attachments. The artwork goes to printing, the cutting drawing to the router, the photo of the finished job to the last step.
gerenciador.occupiesForOfSetupPlus: Occupies {machine} for {occupies}: {setupMinutes} of setup plus production.
gerenciador.hasBeenOnTheTask: has been on the task since

gerenciador.eGForgotTheClock: E.g.: forgot the clock during lunch
gerenciador.aNoteForWhoeverPicks: A note for whoever picks up this task
gerenciador.lastStepFinishingClosesThe: Last step: finishing closes the task and releases whatever is waiting on it.
gerenciador.noOpenRollInThis: No open roll in this department. Open the lot in Stock › Lots choosing the department.
gerenciador.differentMaterialFromTheOne: Different material from the one sold: recorded as a swap.

produtividade.completedTasksSoldTimeComes: Completed tasks. Sold time comes from the build-up; logged time, from the clock. Productivity = sold ÷ logged.
produtividade.below100ProductionTookMore: Below 100 % production took more time than was sold. That isn't an error in itself: it may be time poorly estimated in the build-up or difficulty in execution. The first number is the diagnosis; the target comes from it (GP-33).
produtividade.theSoldTimeSplitIn: The sold time split in proportion to the time each person worked on the task. It's meant to calibrate the estimate and the bonus, not to rank people.
produtividade.noCompletedTasksWithLogged: No completed tasks with logged time yet.
produtividade.timeWithNoSaleMaintenance: Time with no sale (maintenance, cleaning, rework) isn't counted here (GP-34).
produtividade.productivityPerPersonIsVisible: Productivity per person is visible to whoever edits production (manager).
produtividade.youDonTHavePermission: You don't have permission to view productivity.
produtividade.comparesTheTimePlannedIn: Compares the time planned in the build-up with the actual production time.

projetos.deliveryIsAtRiskWhat: Delivery is at risk: what's left in the chain doesn't fit within the deadline.
projetos.oneForEachStepOf: One for each step of the items' build-up, in the size sold. Finishing waits for the base when its type requires it.
projetos.theFirstPromisedDeadlineStays: The first promised deadline stays on record. The production chain is checked again against the new date.
projetos.theProjectIsCreatedWhen: The project is created when the sale is approved: one task for each step of the items' build-up.
projetos.theProjectIsCreatedWhen2: The project is created when the sale is approved.
